searchText: question asked by <@411317441688371202> to <@1369712771683319879> on the breakout call perfect 👌 EVMYulLean is a strong first choice for use as a formal spec. some blockers include that it's not fully up to date. a more subtle reason is that it was a spec designed for smart contract verification and there are some aspects of evm-asm that need a more robust spec (relating to the STF/global state etc) that may not make it a very good guest program spec, as it stands Francesco's EL-IR is very interesting to me as a formal spec language and it might be nicer over the long run But EVMYulLean is by no means ruled out! we just want to think carefully about it, since this could end up growing into a "canonical spec" alongside the Python specs thanks for the detail! i see now that EVMYulLean was designed for smart contract verification, that explains some mismatch > since this could end up growing into a "canonical spec" alongside the Python specs but yes, that would be great and it's why i was asking. i'm hoping we can agree on a canonical spec for everything in lean that needs evm semantics (context: i'm writing a compiler targeting evm, though i'm far from the point where i'll need this)

excerpts.author: dhsorens_26042
excerpts.content: EVMYulLean is a strong first choice for use as a formal spec. some blockers include that it's not fully up to date. a more subtle reason is that it was a spec designed for smart contract verification and there are some aspects of evm-asm that need a more robust spec (relating to the STF/global state etc) that may not make it a very good guest program spec, as it stands

excerpts.author: dhsorens_26042
excerpts.content: Francesco's EL-IR is very interesting to me as a formal spec language and it might be nicer over the long run

excerpts.author: dhsorens_26042
excerpts.content: But EVMYulLean is by no means ruled out!

excerpts.author: dhsorens_26042
excerpts.content: we just want to think carefully about it, since this could end up growing into a "canonical spec" alongside the Python specs
